content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Kansas City

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's secondary-degree and experience thresholds to confirm you meet the baseline. Granite PM Academy's enrollment advisors can verify your qualifications before you enroll in the bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions from your Kansas City location on a schedule that fits your work and life. All instruction is delivered online; you'll earn the full 35 contact hours required by PMI for exam eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, file your PMP application directly with PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy will provide guidance on documentation and submission. PMI reviews your application to confirm eligibility before you schedule your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice exams, study guides, and Q&A support—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your proctored exam through Pearson VUE at a testing center or via remote proctoring. Pass the exam to earn your PMP credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification renews on a three-year cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or project experience. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning resources to help you stay current and meet renewal requirements effortlessly.
